name: Hakase
source:
A doctor who has a small lab. He is kind, gentle, and very knowledgeable.

He always wears a gas mask. As the guardian of Lily and Rosary, the watches over them.

"I'm a mad scientist... self-proclaimed."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
